data.notes: The nightly_rate values are the listed 'Nightly rate' figures, which the document labels as season rates effective from 2026-10-15. Off-season rates (Pine Court Hotel 98.42, The Linden 215.49, Atlas Suites 238.09) were excluded. The document gives no current date, so if the current date is before 2026-10-15 the off-season rates would apply instead.
